content.short: LatAm wallet/neobank with cards and payments.
content.description: Ualá is a Latin American fintech and digital wallet, founded in Argentina, that gives millions of users a prepaid or debit card linked to an app-based account for payments, transfers, and money management. Beyond everyday spending, Ualá offers savings and investment products, personal loans, bill payments, QR payments, and crypto access in some markets, and has expanded across Argentina, Mexico, and Colombia. Aimed at people who are underbanked or dissatisfied with traditional banks, Ualá emphasizes financial inclusion, easy onboarding, and a single app for cards, credit, and investments. By bundling a card, account, and financial products for a large, young, mobile-first population, Ualá competes with banks and other regional fintechs to become a primary financial platform across Spanish-speaking Latin America.
